catalogue.name: Pre Navratri : Couple Pass
catalogue.details: Celebrate Pre Navratri with your entire group of 10 and kick-start the festivities with the energetic Kairavi Buch! Get ready for a vibrant evening filled with traditional Garba beats, festive vibes, and unforgettable moments with your friends and family. This group ticket gives 10 guests access to experience the celebration together and make the most of an unforgettable Navratri night.

Grab your partner, dress in your best traditional attire, and get ready to dance your heart out all night. Enjoy an unforgettable evening filled with energetic Garba beats, vibrant festive vibes, and beautiful moments together. One pass, two guests, and a night full of Navratri memories!
